svg.title: Prepare a practice case for safe review
svg.desc: Another reviewer needs enough facts to check the case while protected details stay private. Check permission. Confirm the approved workspace and purpose. Prepare evidence. Remove identifying details and keep the needed event labels. Handoff. Record what was shared and what the events actually prove.
